title: Among users located in the United Kingdom who have posted at least one ques
question: Among users located in the United Kingdom who have posted at least one question with a favorite count of 4 or more, compute the average number of distinct posts they have voted on that have 'Bayesian' in their title.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(vote_count) FROM (
  SELECT u.XCL_052, COUNT(DISTINCT v.XCL_067) AS vote_count
  FROM users u
  INNER JOIN posts p1 ON u.XCL_052 = p1.XCL_033
  INNER JOIN votes v ON u.XCL_052 = v.XCL_070
  INNER JOIN posts p2 ON v.XCL_067 = p2.XCL_026
  WHERE u.XCL_058 = 'United Kingdom'
    AND p1.XCL_027 = 1
    AND p1.XCL_039 >= 4
    AND p2.XCL_035 LIKE '%Bayesian%'
  GROUP BY u.XCL_052
)

  GROUP BY u.XCL_052
